note: Every sprite of the phase 2 art kit. Paths are under assets/supernaturalbloodlines/textures/gui/ unless they start with assets/ or logo. sprite = the id for blitSprite (supernaturalbloodlines:<sprite>). scaling = what the .mcmeta next to the PNG says: stretch (no file), tile, or nine_slice with slice = left, top, right, bottom (a zero pair means a three-slice along the other axis). glow = has stepped alpha by design.
